paper_title: ASyMOB Algebraic Symbolic Mathematical Operations Benchmark
caption: belowskip=0pt : Effect of equivalence-type perturbations. Note the substantial drop in success rate for most models, even when performance on the seed set is high.

model_annotations.English: The chart illustrates success rates for multiple language models on ASyMOB under a seed condition and several “equivalence-type perturbation” conditions, showing five measurements per model. The horizontal axis contains the model categories (left to right): “Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code),” “Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code),” “Gemini 2.0 Flash (Code),” “Gemini 2.0 Flash (No Code),” “o4-mini (Code),” “o4-mini (No Code),” “GPT-4.1 (Code),” “GPT-4.1 (No Code),” “DeepSeek-R1,” “DeepSeek-Prover-V2,” “DeepSeek-V3,” “Gemma 3 27B,” “Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct,” “Llama 4 Scout,” “GPT-4o,” “GPT-4o mini,” and “Nemotron-Super-v1,” with labels angled diagonally; no explicit sorting cue is indicated beyond this fixed order. The vertical axis is labeled “Success Rate (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 100 with tick marks at regular 20-point intervals. Each model forms a grouped set of five side-by-side bars corresponding to the legend at top-right: “Seed” (dark blue), “‘Equivalence-One-Easy’” (slightly lighter blue), “‘Equivalence-One-Hard’” (medium blue), “‘Equivalence-All-Easy’” (light blue), and “‘Equivalence-All-Hard’” (very light blue). Approximate values by group are: Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code) ~96, ~86, ~83, ~78, ~67; Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code) ~98, ~87, ~85, ~82, ~78; Gemini 2.0 Flash (Code) ~89, ~32, ~33, ~25, ~14; Gemini 2.0 Flash (No Code) ~85, ~30, ~27, ~24, ~12; o4-mini (Code) ~98, ~84, ~80, ~85, ~66; o4-mini (No Code) ~95, ~83, ~80, ~85, ~66; GPT-4.1 (Code) ~65, ~33, ~32, ~14, ~7; GPT-4.1 (No Code) ~79, ~21, ~15, ~16, ~4; DeepSeek-R1 ~93, ~42, ~42, ~43, ~38; DeepSeek-Prover-V2 ~84, ~33, ~30, ~34, ~14; DeepSeek-V3 ~74, ~27, ~21, ~22, ~7; Gemma 3 27B ~77, ~16, ~11, ~9, ~2; Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct ~64, ~24, ~13, ~12, ~3; Llama 4 Scout ~57, ~11, ~8, ~5, ~1; GPT-4o ~54, ~9, ~6, ~4, ~2; GPT-4o mini ~49, ~5, ~3, ~2, ~1; and Nemotron-Super-v1 ~49, ~39, ~23, ~17, ~4. The tallest bars appear near the top of the axis (around ~98% for some seed results), and the shortest bars are near the baseline (around ~1–4% for some “‘Equivalence-All-Hard’” results); there are no special outlines, annotations, or other visual emphasis beyond the color-coded grouping.
model_annotations.German: The chart illustrates success rates for a set of language models evaluated on a seed set and four “equivalence-type perturbation” variants, shown as grouped bars per model. The horizontal axis contains the model categories (left to right: Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code), Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code), Gemini 2.0 Flash (Code), Gemini 2.0 Flash (No Code), o4-mini (Code), o4-mini (No Code), GPT-4.1 (Code), GPT-4.1 (No Code), DeepSeek-R1, DeepSeek-Prover-V2, DeepSeek-V3, Gemma 3 27B, Qwen2.5 72B-Instruct, Llama 4 Scout, GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, Nemotron-Super-v1), with labels rotated diagonally; the vertical axis is labeled “Success Rate (%)” and uses a linear scale from 0 to 100 with evenly spaced tick marks every 20 percentage points. Each model has five adjacent bars in progressively lighter blue shades (as indicated by the legend in the upper right): Seed (darkest), ‘Equivalence-One-Easy’, ‘Equivalence-One-Hard’, ‘Equivalence-All-Easy’, and ‘Equivalence-All-Hard’ (lightest). Approximate bar heights by group are: Gemini 2.5 Flash (Code) ~96, ~86, ~83, ~78, ~67; Gemini 2.5 Flash (No Code) ~99, ~87, ~85, ~82, ~78; Gemini 2.0 Flash (Code) ~89, ~32, ~33, ~25, ~15; Gemini 2.0 Flash (No Code) ~85, ~31, ~28, ~25, ~12; o4-mini (Code) ~99, ~84, ~80, ~85, ~66; o4-mini (No Code) ~95, ~84, ~82, ~85, ~66; GPT-4.1 (Code) ~65, ~33, ~32, ~14, ~7; GPT-4.1 (No Code) ~78, ~21, ~15, ~16, ~4; DeepSeek-R1 ~93, ~42, ~42, ~43, ~38; DeepSeek-Prover-V2 ~84, ~33, ~31, ~34, ~14; DeepSeek-V3 ~74, ~26, ~21, ~22, ~7; Gemma 3 27B ~77, ~16, ~11, ~9, ~2; Qwen2.5 72B-Instruct ~64, ~24, ~13, ~12, ~3; Llama 4 Scout ~57, ~11, ~8, ~4, ~1; GPT-4o ~54, ~10, ~7, ~5, ~3; GPT-4o mini ~49, ~6, ~5, ~3, ~2; Nemotron-Super-v1 ~49, ~39, ~23, ~17, ~4. The bars are presented in the fixed model order shown on the x-axis (not visually sorted by value), and there are no special outlines, callouts, or annotations beyond the legend and axis labeling.
